channel.description: Reported Windows event channel, retaining any tool abbreviation.

computer.description: Computer or host value as reported; not asserted to be a malicious hostname.

event-id.description: Windows Event ID defining the event type; not the record identifier.

event-index.description: One-based document ordinal within the parent detection export result; aggregate members remain distinct.

event-level.description: Windows System.Level as reported; not the detecting rule severity.

event-time.description: Parsed event time only when the timestamp has an explicit timezone and representable precision.

raw-event.description: Normalized JSON event context from the export, including unmapped fields. This is not the original EVTX binary record.

record-id.description: EventRecordID within a log; requires source/host context for identity.

source-evtx.description: Reported source EVTX path/reference. This does not imply that EVTX bytes were acquired or hashed.

timestamp-raw.description: Original event timestamp string, including its precision and timezone when present.

description: Windows event context as reported in a forensic detection export. Record identifiers are scoped to their source log and host; do not merge records by EventRecordID alone.
name: windows-event-log-record
